\section[somvār]{\gu{સોમવાર} (somvār) — Monday}

\label{lesson:GU-C78-monday}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for later, then the Gujarati for before.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{સોમવાર}}
\textbf{\gu{સોમવાર}} (\emph{somvār}) — \textquotedblleft{}Monday\textquotedblright{}. Every day name ends in \textbf{\gu{વાર}}, day.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for monday to friday.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{somvār}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{somvār}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{somvār}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for later, then the Gujarati for before, then say \emph{somvār} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{સોમવાર} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Monday\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
